name: Bella Real Estate Inc
subject: Furniture repair for your units
body:
Hi Bella Real Estate team,

I'm Dillon with Lerega, an upholstery and leather repair shop in Lakeway. When a sofa or chair in one of your units gets damaged, we pick it up, repair it and bring it back, often faster than ordering a new one. We also do better pricing for multiple properties.

Here are a few of our recent projects:
- Apartment complex pool lounge chairs: new covers, Austin (photo)
- Custom lounge seating for an apartment complex (photo)
- Leather sofa: sun fade and color restoration, Austin (photo)
- Custom cushion for a designer apartment bench (photo)

Who on your team would be the right person to talk to about this?

Dillon
(737) 247-7484
dillon@lerega.com

name: Hayes Luxury Resale
subject: Handbag restoration
body:
Hi Hayes Luxury Resale team,

I'm Dillon with Lerega, a handbag and leather repair studio in Lakeway. We restore designer bags (Louis Vuitton, Chanel, Gucci and others): edges, handles, corners, lining and color.

Here are a few of our recent projects:
- Designer handbag: full restoration and cleaning, West Lake Hills (photo)
- Leather handbag: edge, surface and color restoration, Lakeway (photo)
- Red leather handbag: reshaping and restoration (photo)
- Louis Vuitton patent leather bag: color change to black (photo)

If you have bags that need some work before they go on the floor, send me photos and I'll quote them for free. We also have per-bag pricing for resellers.

Dillon
(737) 247-7484
dillon@lerega.com

name: Bobcat Movers
subject: Repair for furniture damaged in moves
body:
Hi Bobcat Movers team,

I'm Dillon with Lerega, an upholstery and leather furniture repair shop in Lakeway. When a customer's sofa or chair gets torn or scuffed in a move, repairing it is usually cheaper than paying out the claim. We turn things around quickly and can pick up.

Here are a few of our recent projects:
- Fabric seam and tear repair (photo)
- Leather sofa: frame repair, cushion reshaping and color restoration, Pflugerville (photo)
- Leather recliner: back panel replacement and color restoration, Buda (photo)
- Leather sofa: panel replacement and full restoration, Georgetown (photo)

Could I send our contact to whoever handles claims?
